Stage 2 integrated community

An annotated conceptual rendering of a Delper community at full Stage 2 maturity (Years 10 to 20), combining housing, energy, water, health, education, and agriculture.

Annotated features

  1. 500+ residential unitsAnthill-style structure housing the community.
  2. Earthquake-resistant coreCentral structure designed to withstand seismic activity.
  3. Reinforced earth constructionSculpted earth-built walls and floors.
  4. Integrated solar matricesSolar arrays across the upper structure and roofs.
  5. Rainwater harvesting systemCollects runoff for community water use.
  6. Delper community hubShared gathering space with solar roofing.
  7. Water ATMDrinking water dispensing point for residents.
  8. Community primary schoolLocal schooling within the community.
  9. Vocational training and engineering centerTraining in trades and engineering skills.
  10. Integrated medical center and telehealth hubOn-site care with remote specialist access.
  11. Ambulance access rampDirect vehicle access for emergency care.
  12. Subterranean seed bank and crop vaultProtected storage for seed and harvested crops.
  13. Tiered livestock shedsStacked livestock housing on the terraced slope.
  14. Agricultural dronesAerial monitoring of farmland.
  15. Automated waste management and processing systemProcesses community waste on site.
  16. Clean rejuvenated lakeRestored water body beside the community.
  17. Sovereign BOOT infrastructure roadAccess road built under the BOOT concession model.
